subject: parser: support the new syntax "show plan for <SQL>" for SPM (#60151)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent: parser-only change adding `SHOW PLAN FOR <stringLit>` via `ShowTargetFilterable`, introducing `ast.ShowPlanForSQL` + `ShowStmt.SQLOrDigest`, restore support, and parser round-trip tests (with regenerated `pkg/parser/parser.go`). No remaining Blocker/High issues on later history: `upstream-master` subsequently removed the `SHOW PLAN FOR <SQL>` syntax entirely (commit 89fccd79d0, PR #62509).
